answer.rationale: The only novel change versus a recurring daily settlement peak is the release that landed ~30 minutes before write-path p99 began climbing; memory_b1 is the closest prior (rollback cleared a post-release checkout failure without customer impact). Circuit breaking is incompatible with not losing customer writes. Failover and read-replica routing have no regional or report-query signal, and b3 describes planned promo headroom rather than an emergency add during a normal daily peak. Cause is still not certain (load may be amplifying a milder regression), settlement writes are high-value, and b1’s archived source should be checked before committing the rollback.
